Subject: It's been a while — new season gear is in
Preview: Fresh arrivals for wherever you're heading next.
Body: Hey,

We noticed it's been some time since you've stopped by. That's fair — life gets busy, and the trails aren't going anywhere.

We have new arrivals in for the season. Whether you're planning a shakedown trip close to home or something bigger on the calendar, it's worth a look to see what's come in.

No pressure, no pitch. Just new stock that's ready when you are.

Come see what's new at Northbay Supply.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
